title: TileShare: Training-Free Acceleration of Overlapping Tiled ViT Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.32233v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fixed-window Vision Transformer (ViT) decoders run at deployment resolution as overlapping tiles: every token in an overlap band is processed by several full decoder instances. In the 2.4B-parameter MiniMax-H3 video decoder, about half of all per-token computation is duplicated. Removing the tiles fails because attention, global tokens and coordinates are bound to them. TileShare keeps each released tile's attention and computes every other operation once per token. The released computation changes at one kind of step only: an overlap token's per-tile results are blended into one shared state with the released weights. Interventions show that this blend costs quality where attention reads the shared states, mainly in the first few layers, which TileShare therefore keeps per tile. translated_title: TileShare：免训练加速重叠平铺式ViT解码
translated_abstract: 固定窗口视觉Transformer（ViT）解码器在部署分辨率下以重叠平铺的方式运行：重叠区域中的每个token都会被多个完整的解码器实例处理。在24亿参数的MiniMax-H3视频解码器中，约一半的每token计算是重复的。直接移除平铺是不可行的，因为注意力、全局token和坐标都与tile绑定。TileShare保留每个被释放tile的注意力，并将其他所有操作对每个token只计算一次。被释放的计算仅在一种步骤上发生变化：重叠token的各tile结果通过被释放的权重混合为一个共享状态。干预实验表明，这种混合在注意力读取共享状态的位置会损害质量，主要集中在前几层，因此TileShare对这些层保留每个tile的独立计算。在无需训练的情况下，在每个tile保留六层，在两种GPU上的解码速度比批处理加编译的平铺方式快1.38-1.51倍（使用FP8最高可达1.96倍），且质量保持等效。
tldr: TileShare通过将重叠token的各tile计算结果混合为共享状态、同时对读取共享状态的前几层注意力保留每tile独立计算，无需训练即可将重叠平铺式ViT解码加速1.38-1.51倍（FP8下最高1.96倍）并保持质量等效。
en_tdlr: TileShare achieves training-free acceleration of overlapping tiled ViT decoding by 1.38-1.51x (up to 1.96x with FP8) with equivalent quality, by blending per-tile results of overlap tokens into shared states while keeping the first few attention-reading layers per tile.
